# EO AI/ML Training

### A 4-day course on AI/ML for Earth Observation

Hands-on machine learning and deep learning with Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 data, built around Philippine case studies in disaster risk reduction, climate change adaptation and natural resource management.
:::

## About This Course

**EO AI/ML Training** is an open course on applying machine learning and deep learning to Earth Observation (EO) data. It was written for EO professionals in the Philippines, and every hands-on lab uses a Philippine case study, but the methods apply anywhere.

::: {.callout-note}
## Course Details

**Author and instructor:** Dimitrios Kasampalis ([Anefelo](https://anefelo.com))
**Format:** 4 days × 4 sessions: slide decks, session pages and Jupyter notebooks that run on Google Colab
**Level:** Intermediate. Basic Python is assumed; EO and ML basics are covered on Day 1
**History:** First delivered as a live online course in October 2025; materials revised and republished in November 2026
**Licence:** [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
:::

The case studies cover three application areas:

- **Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR)**: Sentinel-1 flood mapping, building detection
- **Climate Change Adaptation (CCA)**: drought monitoring and forecasting
- **Natural Resource Management (NRM)**: land cover mapping, forest monitoring

## Course Curriculum

The course goes from EO data fundamentals to deep learning and time-series models. Each day builds on the previous one, and most sessions pair a short theory deck with a hands-on notebook.

### What You'll Be Able to Do

::: {.learning-objectives}
**🎯 Work with EO data**: find, load and preprocess Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 optical data with Python and Google Earth Engine, and know where Philippine EO data comes from (PhilSA, NAMRIA, DOST-ASTI, PAGASA, the CopPhil data infrastructure).

**🤖 Build and evaluate models**: train random forest, CNN, U-Net, object detection and LSTM models for land cover classification, flood mapping, building detection and drought forecasting, and evaluate them with the right metrics.

**🧭 Judge what works**: recognise common pitfalls (data leakage, class imbalance, spatial autocorrelation), and understand where foundation models and other emerging methods fit.

**🌏 Apply it to real problems**: work through Philippine case studies: Palawan (land cover), Central Luzon (flood mapping), Metro Manila (urban object detection) and Mindanao (drought).
:::

## Prerequisites

::: {.prereq-container}
::: {.prereq-section .prereq-required}
<div class="prereq-header">
<i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill"></i>
<h3>Required</h3>
</div>

<div class="prereq-content">
**Technical setup:**

- A Google account (for Colab and Earth Engine)
- A Google Cloud project registered for [noncommercial Earth Engine use](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/guides/access) (free; see the [Setup Guide](resources/setup.qmd))
- Basic Python (variables, loops, functions)
- A modern web browser

::: {.callout-tip collapse="false"}
## No installation needed
All notebooks run in Google Colab. A local Python setup is optional and described in the [Setup Guide](resources/setup.qmd).
:::
</div>
:::

::: {.prereq-section .prereq-recommended}
<div class="prereq-header">
<i class="bi bi-star-fill"></i>
<h3>Helpful Background</h3>
</div>

<div class="prereq-content">
**Helpful knowledge:**

- Basic remote sensing concepts (bands, resolution, sensors)
- Some machine learning vocabulary
- Experience with Jupyter notebooks

::: {.callout-note collapse="false"}
## New to EO or ML?
Day 1 covers the foundations, so you can start there.
:::
</div>
:::
:::

## Getting Started

::: {.callout-important}
## How to use this course

1. **Set up**: follow the [Setup Guide](resources/setup.qmd) (Google account, Colab, Earth Engine Cloud project)
2. **Work through the days in order**: each day page lists its sessions, slide decks and notebooks
3. **Run the notebooks**: open them in Colab from the session pages or the [Materials](resources/downloads.qmd) page
4. **Stuck?** Check the [FAQ](resources/faq.qmd) and the [Glossary](resources/glossary.qmd)

[Start with the Setup Guide →](resources/setup.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
[Jump to Day 1 →](day1/index.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
:::

## Questions, Corrections and Contact

Found an error, a broken link or a notebook that no longer runs? Please open an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/anefelo/eo-ai-ml-training/issues){target="_blank"} and include the session or notebook name, what you expected, and what happened (Colab or local).

For anything else, contact the author at [dimitris@anefelo.com](mailto:dimitris@anefelo.com).
